Hi Alyssa —

Per our renewal cadence, we want to lock the QBR/demo walk for HealthCore. Two constraints you mentioned: exec blackout week later in Nov and a finance procurement walkthrough that needs a live session. To balance both, proposed approach below:

- Option A (preferred): Single 90-minute QBR (accounts + finance + tech) — good for execs but clashes with procurement live requirement.
- Option B (compact lanes): Two 45-minute blocks on the same day.
  - Block 1: Exec + product (high-level roadmap, business impact)
  - Block 2: Tech + procurement (deep dive, security, billing)

Benefits: attendees only join the block relevant to them; procurement gets the live walkthrough without tying up execs for the whole window.

Attached: slot_matrix_v1.xlsx with time options (PST/EST) and a short mutual-action outline in HealthCore_Renewal_MAProposal.pdf.

1) Procurement must be live — is Nov 17 available for them?
2) Preferred daypart for execs (morning vs mid-afternoon PST)?
3) Any firm do-not-schedule windows for your team that day?

If we get quick confirmation, we can send calendar invites with separate access links and a small runbook for hosts. I’ll also propose a fallback: record Block 2 and run a 20-min async follow-up for execs if they can’t attend.
